    The zero ideal generated by a set of arrows #

    For a set S of arrows (irreducible morphisms) of a ray category, the morphisms factoring through an arrow of S form a proper zero ideal (arrSetIdeal, arrSetIdeal_isProper); an arrow lies in it exactly when it is (up to the identification of objects) an arrow of S (mem_of_irreducible). The stages of Fischbacher's Satz 5.1 are the quotients of the universal cover by such ideals.
